# webview

The window and web view of C and C++ applications generated by Clarity:
[webview](https://github.com/webview/webview) 0.12.0, the single header
`core/include/webview/webview.h` of that release, unchanged, under its MIT
license (LICENSE). It draws with WebKitGTK 4.1 on Linux, WebView2 on
Windows and WebKit on macOS. Every generated project carries this copy.
